# tests/fixtures

Fixture data for normalizer and redaction regression tests.

- `normalization/` — (Phase 3) input/expected pairs for each normalizer transformation
- `redaction/` — (Phase 3) adversarial secret corpus for recall/precision measurement
- `poisoning/` — (Phase 5) planted injection payloads in fix.explanation and rawOutputRedacted
- `repositories/` — (Phase 5) small scripted fixture repositories for the evaluation harness
